fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' sprays bullets in a cone toward his facing direction for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all enemies hit and applying a {{tip|stack}} to them at the same tick rate for 2 seconds, refreshing with subsequent hits and stacking up to 4 times. Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|lethality|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}}.
